source.name: SportsPro: 'Toronto FC ink ten-year BMO shirt sponsorship and naming rights renewal'
source.quote: The renewal will see BMO remain the Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment-owned (MLSE) franchise’s main shirt sponsor for the duration of the contract
source.note: Ten-year extension signed June 2022. BMO has been on the shirt since TFC's first season in 2007; the previous extension (2016) was reportedly worth US$4 million a year (Sports Business Journal, via SportsPro). No value reported for the 2022 renewal.

note: Front-of-shirt sponsorship, part of a ten-year BMO partnership renewal announced 23 June 2022 that also retained naming rights to BMO Field. Value of the 2022 renewal not reported.
